The '''Black Sun Ace Fighter Helmet''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate and often worn by their most elite [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] members. The helmet was [[Silver/Legends|silver]] in [[Color/Legends|color]] and had the Black Sun emblem etched into the forehead. It covered the wearer's entire head and face. By the end of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a few of the helmets had fallen into the hands of unaffiliated [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had looted them from wreckages of destroyed Black Sun [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].<ref name="JTL" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Sun Ace Fighter Helmet was a wearable helmet in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']]. It was looted from high-level Black Sun ships in various space [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the game and was quite rare. The helmet could be worn in-game by all playable [[Species/Legends|species]] except [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]].<ref name="JTL" />
